advice_cards.title: Kittle over Andrews stays the right call
advice_cards.text: Mark Andrews caught his first touchdown of the season against the Titans this week, per FantasyPros' news desk. FantasyPros' expert consensus still ranks George Kittle 4th among tight ends for the rest of the season against Andrews' 17th, so the lineup call doesn't change. Andrews found the end zone again, still polishing the view from 17th.

roster_ideas.title: Trade lead: a running back for a tight end, with Samantha
roster_ideas.text: You have seven running backs, and four of them (D'Andre Swift, Jadarian Price, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Kyle Monangai) spent this week on your bench. Juwan Johnson is a perfectly fine tight end, but he's your only one. Samantha has two FantasyPros ranks highly: Sam LaPorta 5th and Dalton Kincaid 6th among tight ends, plus a running back room that's gotten crowded since De'Von Achane's injury. Swift, ranked 11th at running back per FantasyPros, for Kincaid would fix both rosters at once. Worth floating, not a lock.

advice_cards.text: Christian Watson caught all three of his targets for the Packers this week. roster_ideas.title: A backup quarterback is sitting right there
roster_ideas.text: Jalen Hurts is your only rostered quarterback, and he had a rough one Sunday: two touchdowns, but under 100 passing yards. Justin Herbert is a free agent nobody in the league owns, per FantasyPros' ownership numbers, and FantasyPros' expert consensus ranks him 19th among quarterbacks for the rest of the season, miles better than an empty roster spot. One bad week or bye from Hurts and you'd have nowhere to turn. Grab the insurance.
